items.title: A Quiet DNS and Telemetry Stack for the Lab
items.content_text: AdGuard Home in front of Unbound, plus Prometheus and Grafana, for DNS that is predictable and metrics that actually get used.

items.title: Proxmox VE and ZFS: Cluster Notes from a Two-Node Lab

items.title: Segmenting a Homelab with OPNsense and VLANs
